_note: Captured from claude 2.1.296 through @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.232 without a prompt (initializationResult, mcpServerStatus before and after startup, supportedCommands), plus the system/init frame of a free local /context command. Field names, order and value shapes are as captured, including the undeclared `builtin` flag and empty argumentHint strings. Personal skills, plugins, servers, paths, ids and URLs are invented; long descriptions are shortened.
